credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: This is the album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe "in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River." The album consisting of 89 photographs taken by Todd Webb documents the seven-day, 180-mile Colorado River Raft trip that would follow the routes of John Wesley Powell and Norman Neville.  The 11 participants of the rafting trip group included Georgia O'Keeffe, Todd Webb, Eliot Porter, Steve Porter, Kathy Porter, Tish Frank, Doris Bry, Quida Ball, Mike Harding, Marhsall Girard ( Sandra Girard's son), and Kenney Ross, a guide from Moab.
title: Glen Canyon Album: Colorado River Raft Trip
